lines.text: Many learners say: The shop made me a discount.
Better: The shop gave me a discount.
We give or get a discount. We do not make one.
Gave! The shop gave me a discount.

data.wrong: The shop made me a discount.
data.right: The shop gave me a discount.
data.why: We give or get a discount. We do not make one.
